name: Cops
overview: Scripture recognizes those who maintain peace and order as blessed and aligned with God's purposes, calling peacemakers the children of God. Civil authorities, including law enforcement, serve as ministers of God to promote good and restrain evil, wielding authority as a divine ordinance. Resisting such authority is equated with resisting God's established order and brings judgment, underscoring the importance of respecting and honoring those who uphold justice.
